summary.headline: Data Patterns Q1 FY27 revenue rose 17% YoY to Rs 116 crore, EBITDA margin fell to about 27%, and order book reached Rs 2,654 crore including negotiated orders.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations grew 17% YoY to Rs 116 crore, with gross profit up 16% to Rs 91.5 crore and gross margin at 78.9%. EBITDA was Rs 31.4 crore (about 27% margin) and PAT Rs 22.1 crore, with the PAT margin depressed by an uneven-quarter tax effect of about 19%. Margins were hit by higher employee costs for capability expansion, other expenses (repairs during facility revamp and about Rs 2 crore of receivable provisions), and uneven revenue recognition. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of 20-25% revenue growth and a 40% EBITDA margin range, and said fresh order inflows of about Rs 2,000 crore are expected in FY27 beyond the negotiated book.

financial_highlights.change: tax rate elevated due to uneven quarterly revenue

financial_highlights.metric: Order book incl. orders received in July and negotiated

segments.name: Radar, EW, avionics and auto battery test equipment
segments.commentary: Management cited new orders across avionics, radar, electronic warfare and auto battery test equipment from DRDO, HAL and other customers. Quantum of individual orders was not disclosed.

segments.name: Drone and counter-drone
segments.commentary: Initial orders received; management sees active detection radars, passive ELINT/COMINT and jamming products as addressable areas. Addressable market cited as over Rs 40,000 crore, with no revenue guidance.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: First export order (antenna for a UK customer) received last year, with delivery expected in 6-8 months. Management expects export business to scale over 2-3 years; no quantum given.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 20-25% reiterated.
EBITDA margin guidance in the 40% range reiterated; management said quarterly margins will vary with revenue levels.
Employee costs expected to remain elevated over coming quarters for engineering talent investment.
Fresh order inflows of about Rs 2,000 crore targeted in FY27, over and above the existing order book and negotiated orders.
Capex of about Rs 200 crore or more planned over the next two years for infrastructure, clean rooms, integration facilities and production lines.
Negotiated orders of about Rs 1,726 crore (Rs 2,654 crore less Rs 920 crore) expected to convert into contracts in roughly 2 months to a few months; HAL order excluded from the negotiated figure.
capex_capacity: Capex of about Rs 200 crore plus over the next two years for infrastructure, car parks, clean rooms and integration facilities; foundation work already started.
Production lines and test equipment to be set up as volume orders arrive; investments run in parallel with order execution.
Large antenna division in place; management said it designs antennas in-house.
Additional infrastructure purchases for production and calibration for counter-drone products ahead of contracts.
Investment in AI-related computer servers flagged as part of capex.
demand_pricing: Revenue recognition is lumpy: customer inspection and approval delays shifted some revenue out of Q1; management did not quantify the slipped amount.
Negotiated order conversion slowed because a large program was stretched by more than 1.5 years; management said order conversion is now expected within weeks to months.
Possible HAL order (reportedly L1 in one contract, over Rs 1,000 crore per prior commentary) is excluded from the negotiated figure and is not yet confirmed.
Su-30 ammunition-related product: customer satisfied; quality exercises and flight trials expected before December, with commercial orders after that.
Seeker orders for the Akash/Astra-type program expected this year; these are development orders and not part of FY27 revenue guidance per management.
Sinshakti / electronic warfare suite: interactions ongoing; management could not confirm receipt of an RFP.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses rise about 64% on 17% revenue growth, and was any revenue slipped out of Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Other expenses rose on extra repairs and maintenance during facility revamp and about Rs 2 crore of provisions against long-pending receivables. Management did not quantify revenue slipped due to customer approval delays, citing customer sensitivity.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for the about Rs 1,726 crore of negotiated orders to convert into order book?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said delays were due to a large program stretched more than 1.5 years and extended approval stages. Negotiations are complete for those orders; conversion expected within about 2 months, with some orders still in protracted negotiation.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline and revenue for the Su-30 ammunition product?
qa_highlights.answer: Customer is satisfied with progress; quality exercises and flight trials are expected before December, with commercial contracts after specification sign-off. Management declined to quantify expected business.

qa_highlights.question: Why were margins lower this quarter, and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed lower margin to high people costs (which it said are among the highest in the industry) and uneven revenue across quarters with a fixed cost base. It said full-year margin target remains achievable.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the seeker and counter-drone opportunities, and the potential acquisition of FD Advanced?
qa_highlights.answer: Seeker commercial orders expected in 2026; the revenue impact is not in FY27 projections. Counter-drone active and passive detection products are at early order stage. The FD Advanced acquisition is for advanced composites, with strategy still being finalised.

qa_highlights.question: What is the addressable market and timing of the Rs 40,000 crore opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited addressable market of about Rs 30,000 crore from new products plus Rs 10,000 crore from repeat contracts, but said timing was not yet clear and these opportunities are not included in the Rs 2,000 crore FY27 inflow target.

risks_watch: Revenue lumpiness and dependence on customer inspection and approvals; Q1 revenue slipped and quarterly margins are volatile.
Order conversion delays: negotiated orders (about Rs 1,726 crore) and the HAL order depend on contract signing.
Margin pressure from elevated employee costs and other expenses, with receivable provisions of about Rs 2 crore.
Execution risk on FY27 guidance of 20-25% revenue growth and about 40% margin, with the order book at Rs 920 crore executable only.
Strategic bets (counter-drone, exports, Hawk radar, space) are at early stages with no revenue visibility; capex and R&D spend ramping.
Acquisition of FD Advanced (advanced composites) with strategy not yet finalised.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term opportunities and guidance, but cautious and evasive on specific timelines and values for orders, revenue slippage and the Su-30 and seeker programs. Management repeatedly declined to quantify conversion timing and deflected several margin and order-book questions.
key_quotes: We remain confident of achieving our full year guidance growth in the 20 to 25 percent revenue growth while maintaining a bit of margin certified 40 percent range.
We are a yearly business and all the projects are long term.
Our order book stands for 2654 cores including orders negotiated providing healthy revenue visibility over the coming years.
